body.archive: Any route that replays accepts `archive` (query or body): an archival RPC that honours a historical slot, e.g. Alchemy's Account Archive, for exact state at the transaction's slot. Same opt-in and vetting as `rpc`.
body.description: Solana transaction simulation layer — decode, replay, mutate, assert.

endpoints.GET /account/{address}: An account decoded through its program's layout or IDL.
endpoints.GET /analyze/{signature}: Decode a transaction: CPI tree, balance & token changes, compute, and IDL-decoded accounts.
endpoints.GET /analyze_at/{signature}?slot=N: The whole transaction page rebuilt from a replay as of any slot (own slot when omitted): call tree, balances, token balances, compute, logs, plus the certificate.
endpoints.GET /counterfactual/{signature}?account: Binary-search the lamport balance at which the outcome flips.
endpoints.GET /diagnose/{signature}: A failure explained: error name, docs, the step and accounts involved.
endpoints.GET /freeze/{signature}: Capture a self-contained fixture for deterministic, offline replay.
endpoints.GET /instructions/{program}: The instructions a program's on-chain IDL declares.
endpoints.GET /profile/{signature}: The as-it-happened compute profile, no symbols, cacheable.
endpoints.GET /replay/{signature}: Re-execute the transaction locally against reconstructed pre-state.
endpoints.GET /replay_at/{signature}?slot=N: Replay against the world as of any slot (exact for every account recorded across it, labelled otherwise), with the same certificate.
endpoints.GET /replay_at_slot/{signature}: Replay against state reconstructed at the transaction's slot, with a per-account fidelity certificate.
endpoints.GET /scan/{signature}: Which accounts, when drained, change the outcome.
endpoints.GET /trace/{signature}: The same trace with no mutations, cacheable.
endpoints.POST /decode_account: { owner, data_b64 } — decode raw account bytes.
endpoints.POST /idl_instructions: { idl } — the same, for an IDL supplied in the request.
endpoints.POST /preflight: { transaction, mutations[] } — simulate an UNSIGNED transaction against current state before sending.
endpoints.POST /preflight_report: { transaction, mutations[] } — preflight as an HTML report.
endpoints.POST /profile: { signature, mutations[]?, time_travel?, features?, symbols[{program, elf_b64}]? } — compute profiler: every BPF instruction attributed to functions, syscalls and call stacks per program frame; symbols name a program's functions from its .debug file.
endpoints.POST /replay_report: { signature, scenarios[] } — a suite run as an HTML report.
endpoints.POST /simulate: { signature, mutations[], time_travel?, features? } — replay with what-if account mutations, an optional clock warp, and optional runtime feature-gate toggles.
endpoints.POST /simulate_suite: { signature, scenarios[], time_travel?, features? } — run a suite of scenarios with outcome + state assertions, under optional feature-gate toggles.
endpoints.POST /trace: { signature | transaction, mutations[], time_travel?, features? } — step debugger: every instruction and CPI with decoded args, per-step account diffs, and the failing step.

body.name: svmscope
